prompt: In what round of the Nations Cup team competition at the FEI European Championships did a member of the jump crew interfere with Cian O'Connor and Good Luck?
answer: The interference occurred during the **second round of the Nations Cup team competition**—the **Round 2 team final** at the 2015 FEI European Championships in Aachen.
